description: Search the Synoptic stream catalog by keyword. Matches stream names, labels, descriptions, categories, and IDs; does not search post text or accounts on other services. Returns active public streams without sign-in; a signed-in user also gets private streams they own, follow, subscribe to, or were invited to. Results are ordered by follower count, not relevance. Returns the ID, name, description, and Synoptic page URL of each match. Use get_stream to inspect a result before reading posts or configuring targets.

limit.description: Maximum number of streams in this page; defaults to 10

offset.description: Number of matching records to skip; starts at 0 and increases by limit for the next page

query.description: One or a few keywords; every word must match a stream name, label, description, category, or ID

name: search

hasMore.description: True when another page of matching streams is available; request it with offset increased by limit

streams.description: Matching streams in this page, ordered by follower count

url.description: Synoptic web page for the stream; private streams require sign-in

total.description: Number of streams returned in this page

title: Find streams
